messages:
eli: quick sync — we need a concise playbook for schema gating across traces/metrics/logs. options: require explicit header + fast path, runtime translator service, or opt-in client-side validation. leaning header-first but need migration safety. thoughts?
sasha: header-first reduces runtime work and makes routing simpler. but SDK adoption will be uneven. need fallback for older clients.
marta: agree. fallback should be non-blocking: shadow-translate for a period, durable buffering if translate fails, and a replay tool for owners to reprocess.
ben: operational concern: where do transforms live? prefer a separate transform-service (sandboxed) to keep ingest binary small. small common renames could live in gateway for perf. cost tradeoff: service adds ~3-5ms p95.
eli: can we split paths: if X-ri-schema present -> fastpath ingest; else route to translator. translator must be autoscaled and multitenant with CPU quotas per-tenant.
sasha: +1. add tenant config: compat_mode = [managed, require-header, self-hosted]. default = managed for hosted tenants created before cutoff. Dedicated can pick self-hosted.
marta: implement a negotiation endpoint for SDKs: POST /v1/schema/negotiate -> returns recommended version + test_vector. SDK CI can call this before shipping.
ben: tooling: obs-compat CLI for SDK owners:
```
obs-compat --schema ./v2.json --samples ./batch.ndjson --staging https://staging-obsv.gateway
# output: pass: 98.7%; failures: missing service.version in 1.3%
```
ops-bot: queued: replay job id=rb-276912-01 accepted to obs-backlog.
eli: migration plan sketch: 1) add header parsing + routing 2) deploy translator (non-mutating shadow mode) + collect divergence 3) ship SDK negotiation + obs-compat CLI 4) run shadow transforms 0.1%->1%->10% with divergence alerts 5) open opt-in fastpath for upgraded tenants 6) deprecate shim after 3 months of stable low traffic.
sasha: metrics to capture: header_fraction, shadow_divergence_pct (hash compare), transform_latency_p50/p95, transform_cpu_seconds_by_tenant, billing_key_stability. retention 120d for migration audits.
marta: canary gates: start at 0.1% shadow; alert if divergence >0.3% or transform error rate delta >0.5%. ramp steps: 0.1 -> 1 -> 10 -> 50 -> 100.
ben: billing policy: Hosted absorbs baseline translator CPU during grace window (90d). After that, tenants using server-side transforms either pay transform surcharge or self-host. add tenant flag transform_payment=[hosted, tenant, self-hosted].
eli: security: require signed transform bundles in registry, verify signature in translator, log audit event for any mutation of billing keys. schema-bot: bundle publish recorded: bundle=v2-normalize id=bnd-276912 signed-by=marta.
sasha: replay tooling: obs-replay to re-run buffered raw envelopes through a target bundle locally before flipping clients. example:
```
obs-replay --bundle bnd-276912 --input obs-backlog/2026-03-10.ndjson --out ./replayed.ndjson
```
marta: owners: eli (product lead), sasha (routing + header spec), ben (translator + infra), infra (buffer + monitors), marta (schema registry + tooling). I'll write RFC with timeline + sample dashboards. can everyone ack by EOD? :eyes:
eli: ack.
sasha: ack.
ben: ack.
ops-bot: RFC created: https://rfc.internal/obs-schema-gating-2769123456 (assigned marta).
